correctness.rationale: The exact five-bit Boolean rule defines all cyclic F_N for N>=2, including colliding indices at short periods. From y_i the four-state reverse map R_e(a,b,c,d)=(e+c+a(1+b)d,a,b,c) is algebraically immediate. The four computed 8-element image sheets S_(a,b)=R_a R_b(F_2^4) admit bijective transitions S_(a,b)->S_(e,a). The two explicit root loops give rank permutations alpha=(0,4,1,5,6,2,3,7), beta=(1,0,3,6,4,5,7,2) generating all 40320 elements of S8; root lifted loops have coprime lengths 6 and 35, so the 4*40320-state skew graph is irreducible and aperiodic. Perron-Frobenius gives exponential equidistribution of monodromy; fixed points produce the exact nine rencontres numerators (14833,14832,7420,2464,630,112,28,0,1). Independent reconstruction of reverse maps, closure, and forward cyclic fiber histograms for N=2..11 corroborated the graph correspondence. The analytic primitive-matrix argument, not finite examples, gives all-N asymptotics. No exactly seven fixed points is a combinatorial impossibility for S8.
